resolution: STALE-VERIFIED 2026-08-11: PR #428 / ADR-0085 (release-at-decline) closes every branch of this shape — validateContinuation declines a binding whose snapshot is landed/deleted/conflicted, and adoptContinuationAfterTriage RELEASES the declined binding (releaseDeclinedBinding), so no later lane inherits it; a reaped ancestor ledger degrades to the non-blocking 'left no reconcilable ledger' WARNING (readDefectLedger not-exist path), never an audit FAIL. Cycle-1418's exact shape (binding to landed+superseded state) = AlreadyLanded classify -> decline -> release. Adoption always precedes audit in the spine, so the gate can never see a binding adoption hasn't screened.
summary: Two cycles of the 2026-08-09/10 batches failed audit with 'this workspace holds no continuation manifest, but the root-owned continuation-registry.json binds this lane's scope to cycle-N — the manifest was deleted or never written'. The registry (root-owned, long-lived) and the per-cycle continuation-manifest.json (workspace-scoped, reaped with runs/worktrees) have different lifecycles, so a registry binding can outlive its manifest: any later lane matching that scope inherits an unsatisfiable audit precondition. Cycle-1418 hit it on a binding to cycle-1405 whose work had ALREADY landed console-first (PRs #422/#426) — the binding pointed at superseded, deleted state. ROOT-CAUSE FIX: make the binding's validity depend on its manifest's existence — either (a) the audit gate treats a registry binding whose manifest is absent as a STALE binding (log loudly, release it, grade the lane WITHOUT inherited scope) rather than an audit FAIL, or (b) registry writes/releases become transactional with manifest create/reap (release on worktree reap, on snapshot supersession, and on inbox-item consumption). Include a regression test: registry binds cycle-N, manifest absent -> lane audit does NOT fail on the binding and the release is logged; plus a test that a LIVE binding (manifest present) still enforces inheritance. Evidence: runs/cycle-1412 + runs/cycle-1418 audit-fail-reason.json; .evolve/continuation-registry.json entries for the schema-aligned-salvage-layer and defect-disposition lanes.
title: continuation-registry binds a lane scope to a cycle whose continuation manifest no longer exists — audits fail on bookkeeping, not work (cycles 1412 and 1418)
